summary.content: I am a highly experienced Senior Laravel Developer and Project Manager with a proven track record in architecting and delivering high-performance web applications. My expertise spans the full software development lifecycle, from robust backend development and API design to seamless system integration and deployment. As a Project Manager, I excel at leading cross-functional teams, fostering clear communication, and implementing agile methodologies to ensure projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and within budget. My passion lies in leveraging cutting-edge technologies to solve real-world problems and create impactful digital experiences.

responsibilities: Led development and scaling of the AI-powered educational platform used by 10K+ users
Implemented core backend systems using Laravel, integrating OpenAI API for custom AI assistants and voice-to-text features
Optimized database queries and system architecture, reducing application response time by 40%
Managed AWS infrastructure (SES, S3) for email communication and file storage, ensuring 99.9% uptime
Mentored 5+ junior developers, establishing coding standards and best practices for the team
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver project milestones on schedule
Oversaw end-to-end development of the Workzone1 Time Tracker & PM Tool with NextJS frontend and NestJS backend
Implemented Agile/Scrum methodologies, reducing project delivery time by 30%
Coordinated with 12+ developers, designers, and QA specialists to ensure alignment with client requirements
Managed AWS deployment (Amplify, EC2) and integrated Google Maps API for location-based features
Maintained regular client communication with weekly progress updates
Lead a cross-functional team of 25+ developers on enterprise-level web application projects
Streamlined project workflows and implemented risk management strategies, reducing delivery delays by 25%
Facilitate client meetings to define project scope, requirements, and success metrics
Monitor project budgets and resource allocation to deliver within financial constraints
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance team productivity
Delivered 50+ custom web development projects for clients globally with 100% client satisfaction on Upwork
Maintain a YouTube channel with Laravel, PHP, and web development tutorials for 10K+ subscribers
Provide freelance consulting for backend architecture design and project management
Built and managed client projects using Laravel, MySQL, Docker, and AWS
Authored technical blog posts sharing web development best practices
